description_en: Updates a SaaS domain name. You can modify the bound record ID, certificate type, and other settings
description_zh: 更新 SaaS 域名，支持修改绑定的记录 ID、证书类型等
name: UpdateCustomHostname

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SaaS domain name. You can obtain the ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/3018667.html operation
parameters.help_zh: SaaS 域名的 ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/3018667.html接口获取
parameters.name: hostname_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the record to bind. You can obtain the ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850265.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 待绑定记录的ID，可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850265.html获取
parameters.name: record_id

parameters.help_en:
The SSL switch. Valid values:
on: Enables SSL.
off: Disables SSL
parameters.help_zh:
SSL开关。
on: 开启 SSL。
off: 关闭 SSL
parameters.name: ssl_flag

parameters.help_en:
The certificate type. This parameter is required when SslFlag is set to on. Valid values:
free: free certificate.
upload: uploaded certificate.
cas: SSL Certificates Service certificate
parameters.help_zh:
证书类型，SslFlag 为 on 时需要输入该参数。
free: 免费证书。
upload: 上传证书。
cas: 云盾证书
parameters.name: cert_type

parameters.help_en: The certificate content. This parameter is required when CertType is set to upload
parameters.help_zh: 证书内容，CertType 为 upload 时需要输入该参数
parameters.name: certificate

parameters.help_en: The certificate private key. This parameter is required when CertType is set to upload
parameters.help_zh: 证书私钥，CertType 为 upload 时需要输入该参数
parameters.name: private_key

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SSL Certificates Service certificate. This parameter is required when CertType is set to cas
parameters.help_zh: 云盾证书 ID，CertType 为 cas 时需要输入该参数
parameters.name: cas_id

parameters.help_en:
The region of the SSL Certificates Service certificate. This parameter is required when CertType is set to cas. Valid values:
Chinese mainland accounts: cn-hangzhou.
International accounts: ap-southeast-1
parameters.help_zh:
云盾证书地域，CertType 为 cas 时需要输入该参数。
中国站账号传参数值：cn-hangzhou。
国际站账号传参数值：ap-southeast-1
parameters.name: cas_region
